APPTECH Italy Prototype Wheels for Alfa Romeo Giulia GTA / GTAm

20-inch prototype wheels by APPTECH Italy for the Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio, styled after the factory Alfa Romeo Giulia GTA and GTAm wheels and sized for the Giulia platform.

The setup is staggered: the rear wheels are wider than the fronts, which allows wider rear tires for more grip under hard acceleration. The narrower front wheels keep steering response and handling balanced.


Specifications

Front: 9.5J × 20" ET23
Rear: 11J × 20" ET29


Key Features

• Designed for the Alfa Romeo Giulia platform
• Styled after the factory Giulia GTA & GTAm wheels
• APPTECH Italy prototype design
• Staggered fitment with 11J rear and 9.5J front wheels
• For road cars and track builds

Alfa Romeo Giulia GTA / GTAm Hub Bearing with Toolhead.
The kit is made for the Alfa Romeo Giulia GTA and GTAm. The central lock nut uses a left-hand thread on one side of the car and a right-hand thread on the other, so the nut does not loosen under load. The kit also includes a star locking plate that secures the central lock nut and a protective center cap. Parts are made to OEM tolerances for correct alignment on the street and on track.

Alfa Romeo Giulia GTA / GTAm Exhaust System. Scans only include the visible parts of the exhaust system, such as the muffler and tailpipes. The internal components of the exhaust system, such as the catalytic converter and resonator, are not included in the scans due to their location and complexity.
